Part 1

# Let f(x) = log f(x)
Log-density function: log_f

``` {r}
# f(x) = 0.5 * exp(-abs(x)) 
# log f(x) = log(0.5) - (abs(x))
  log_f <- function(x) {
    return(-abs(x))
  }
``` 

# Random Walk Metropolis Function

``` {r}
rwm_sampler <- function(x0, N, s) {
  #Initialize the chain vector to store random numbers
  chain <- numeric(N+1)
  chain[1] <- x0
  
  #Set the current state (xi-1)
  xi_minus_1 <- x0
  
  #Loop for N iterations
  for (i in 1:N) {
    # Simulate a random no. x* 
    x_star <- rnorm(1, mean = xi_minus_1, sd=s)
    
    #Compute log ratio
    log_ratio <- log_f(x_star) - log_f(xi_minus_1)
    
    #Generate a random number u from Uniform(0,1) and calc log u
    log_u <- log(runif(1))
    
    #Acceptance Criterion; log u < log_ratio
    if (log_u < log_ratio) {
           xi <- x_star } 
         else {
          xi <- xi_minus_1 }
    
    #Store the new state and update the current state
    chain[i+1] <- xi
    xi_minus_1 <- xi
    }
    
    #Return the generated samples (x1,...,xN) excluding initial x0
  return(chain[-1])
}
``` 

a. 
``` {r}
N_a <- 10000
s_a <- 1
x0_a <- 5

sample_a <- rwm_sampler(x0=x0_a, N=N_a, s=s_a)

sample_mean <- mean(sample_a)
sample_sd <- sd(sample_a)

print(sample_mean)
print(sample_sd)
``` 

``` {r}
N <- 10000
s <- 1
x0 <- 0

for (i in 1) {
  x_star <- rnorm(1, mean=x0, sd=s)
  
  log_ratio <- (-abs(x_star)) - (-abs(x0))
  log_u <- log(runif(1))
  
  if (log_u < log_ratio)
    x0 <- x_star
}
``` 

Creating Histogram and Overlaying KDE
``` {r}
# Create the Histogram (set up the figure and axes)
hist(sample_a, 
     breaks = 60, 
     freq = FALSE, 
     main = "Estimated Density Overlay",
     xlab = "x",
     ylab = "Density",
     col = "grey",
     border = "black")

# Overlay the Kernel Density Estimate (KDE)
# calculate the density and use lines() to draw it on the existing plot.
lines(density(sample_a), 
      col = "blue", 
      lwd = 2)

z <- seq(min(sample_a), max(sample_a), length.out = 400)
lines(z, 0.5 * exp(-abs(z)), col = "pink", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# 4. Add the Legend
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Sample Histogram", "KDE (Estimated)", "True Density (Theoretical)"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "pink"), 
       lty = c(1, 1, 2),     # Line types: 1 is solid, 2 is dashed
       lwd = c(1, 2, 2),     # Line widths
       fill = c("grey", NA, NA), # Fill the first box with grey for the histogram
       border = c("black", NA, NA), 
       bty = "n",            # Removes the box around the legend
       cex = 0.8)            # Adjusts font size to fit well

``` 

b.
# $W = \frac{1}{J} \sum_{j=1}^{J} V_j
# $$B = \frac{N}{J-1} \sum_{j=1}^{J} (M_j - M)^2
# $$R = \frac{B + W}{W}$

``` {r}
calculate_R <- function(chains) { 
J <- length(chains)
  N <- length(chains[[1]])
  
  M_j <- sapply(chains,mean)
  
  V_j <- sapply(chains,var)
  
  W <- mean(V_j)
  
  M <- mean(M_j)
  
  B <- (N / (J-1))* sum((M_j - M)^2)
  
  R <- (B+W)/W
  
  return(R)
  }
  
``` 

``` {r}
N_b <- 2000
s_b <- 0.001
J_b <- 4

# Use large, widely spaced initial values
x0_values <- c(-30, -15, 15, 30)

chains_b <- list()
for (j in 1: J_b) {
  chains_b[[j]] <- rwm_sampler( x0 = x0_values[j], N=N_b, s=s_b)
}

R_value_specific <- calculate_R(chains_b)
``` 

``` {r}
N_fixed <- 2000
J_fixed <- 4
x0_fixed <- c(-30, -15, 15, 30)

# FIXED: Create a grid of exactly 1000 values from 0.001 to 1.0
s_grid <- seq(0.001, 1.0, length.out = 1000)

R_values_s_grid <- numeric(length(s_grid))

# This loop might take 1-2 minutes to finish!
for(k in 1:length(s_grid)) {
  s_current <- s_grid[k]
  chains_current <- list()
  
  for(j in 1:J_fixed) {
    chains_current[[j]] <- rwm_sampler(x0 = x0_fixed[j], N = N_fixed, s = s_current)
  }
  R_values_s_grid[k] <- calculate_R(chains_current)
}

s_optimal <- s_grid[which.min(R_values_s_grid)]

print(s_optimal)
``` 

``` {r}
# Plot the results
plot(s_grid, R_values_s_grid, 
     type = "l",          # FIXED: Changed from "b" to "l" (line) for 1000 points
     col = "pink", 
     lwd = 2,
     main = "R-Value Convergence Diagnostic vs. Proposal Standard Deviation (s)",
     sub = paste0("N = ", N_fixed, ", J = ", J_fixed, ". Optimal s ≈ ", round(s_optimal, 4)),
     xlab = "Proposal Standard Deviation (s)",
     ylab = "R Value (Gelman-Rubin Diagnostic)")

# Add the convergence threshold line
abline(h = 1.05, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)

# Highlight the Optimal s value with a single diamond point
points(s_optimal, min(R_values_s_grid), 
       col = "blue", pch = 18, cex = 2)

# Legend sitting inside the top-right of the box
legend("topright", 
       legend = c("Calculated R Value", "R=1.05 Threshold", paste("Optimal s =", round(s_optimal, 4))), 
       col = c("pink", "red", "blue"), 
       lty = c(1, 2, NA),
       pch = c(NA, NA, 18), # Only the third item (optimal s) gets a symbol
       lwd = c(2, 1.5, NA),
       cex = 0.8,
       bty = "n")
``` 

``` {r}
# Original:
for (j in 1:J_fixed) {
  chains_current[[j]] <- rwm_sampler(x0 = x0_fixed[j], N = N_fixed, s = s_current)
}

# New:
chains_current <- lapply(x0_fixed, function(x0) {
  rwm_sampler(x0 = x0, N = N_fixed, s = s_current)
})
```
